title: Shapes shared by the rulebook's schemas (schema v2)

binding.description: the language a check binds to; a part lists the ones it uses

strength.description: how a rule is held; decision 44 says which bind. Later is removed: it is status later with when

waiver.description: never; native: the tool's own disable comment with a mandatory reason; recorded: an entry in the project's .rulebook/waivers.yaml

facets.description: facets a project declares, each named by a part in parts.yaml

paths.description: slash-separated globs, from the project root

kinds.description: the product is one of these kinds

facets.description: the product declares every one of these facets

paths.description: only files matching one of these globs

when.description: where a part or rule applies; every field given must hold, and an absent field holds

unless.description: where a rule does not apply although when holds: an entry matches when every field it gives holds

where.description: the place inside the source: a chapter, a section, a heading

says.description: what the source says there, at most 40 words

covers.description: only for a source of kind external-rule: this rule holds the external rule as written (equal) or more (stricter)
